name: Suzumiya Rion
source:
Rion is a graceful, serious, and studious high school girl!
She is the most beautiful girl in the school,
and she suddenly approaches you, whom she is not very close to!
But her eyes sometimes clouded over with sadness and…
When Rion's secret is revealed, their love begins to unfold! 

[From the [url=https://oshinovel.com/oshikano/tt]official website[/url]]
